capabilities: Render teaser cards from fenced teaser code blocks
Add centered title and text overlays
Apply gradient overlay and hover-lift styling
extras: README is in German. The author states it is an initial, simple implementation and that resolving Obsidian internal image links (![[Attachment.png]]) is not yet supported; no reviewed-plugin assurance beyond the standard notice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a code block into a styled, clickable image card within a note.
summary: Renders a clickable image teaser card (background image, centered title and text, gradient overlay, hover-lift) from a fenced teaser code block.
